rules.text: Ability: dexterity. Utilize: Pick a lock (DC 15), or disarm a trap (DC 15). Craft: no listed products. Tool proficiency adds PB to ability checks using the tool; if also proficient in a skill used with the check, gain Advantage. Each Artisan tool needs its own proficiency.

authored_operations: Utilize chooses one task: Pick a lock (DC 15), or disarm a trap (DC 15). Use dexterity, the declared DC and actual tool copy; apply PB for the matching proficiency and Advantage when the applicable skill is also proficient.
Crafting needs the source procedure, materials, time, proficiency and legal result definition; this list grants no products. Keep unavailable craft consumers explicit rather than synthesizing items.

definition.name: Thieves' Tools
definition.description: A set of lockpicks and tools for disarming traps.

definition.name: Thieves' Tools
definition.description: This set of tools includes a small file, a set of lock picks, a small mirror mounted on a metal handle, a set of narrow-bladed scissors, and a pair of pliers. Proficiency with these tools lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to disarm traps or open locks.
